name: @yilmaz/mobile
description: Android uygulaması (Anadolu Ailesi): web/dist'i Capacitor ile paketler.

scripts.sync: npm --prefix ../web run build && cap sync android
scripts.apk: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.release: npm run sync && cd android && JAVA_HOME=$(ls -d ~/.jdks/jdk-21* 2>/dev/null | head -1 || echo $JAVA_HOME) ./gradlew assembleRelease bundleRelease
